structured_output.what_is_happening: PROM is the token tied to PromX (promx.fun), a small new pump.fun-based launchpad. Coins launched through it send their pump.fun creator fees into a pool, and holders who post about the coin on X (tagging @usePromX and #ad) get paid in SOL from that pool. The token launched at about 12:11 UTC and moved to PumpSwap within about 6 minutes. It reached an all-time high of about $342k market cap, then fell roughly 70-85%. It is now bouncing hard: GeckoTerminal shows +164% over 30 minutes and +58-62% over 5 minutes, and DexScreener currently has the price near $0.000114, about $110k market cap. Six-hour volume is about $1.6M, which is extreme turnover for this size. That volume comes with heavy bot activity: GMGN counts 550 bundler wallets, 1,000 fresh wallets and a 43% bot/degen rate. The token also has 10 paid DexScreener boosts, a community-takeover flag, and the creator has sold out ('creator_close').

narrative.description: The story is 'paid-to-shill' fee sharing: pump.fun creator fees get sent to holders who promote a coin on X. It fits the current creator-fee meta on pump.fun, and the product is live. It is very small, though: about 2 SOL paid out across 84 posts, with about 11.4 SOL sitting in reward pools. The mechanism is built to reward promotion.
narrative.why_spreading: The product is live and pays for posts, so it produces self-promotion (#ad posts) rather than organic spread. On top of that come paid DexScreener boosts and bot/bundler volume. I found no news, Reddit or independent coverage.

token_connection.why_this_token: The pump.fun metadata links promx.fun and a status post by @usePromX. The name matches, and the description is the site's tagline. This pair was created at 12:17 UTC, before the clones in the packet, all of which were created between about 12:18 and 13:05 UTC. The site itself shows no official PROM contract address, and I could not read the linked X post (HTTP 402), so I could not confirm it is the official token.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least 8 PROM clones launched within the next hour, all with $0 liquidity and no volume now. There is also an unrelated older PROM token on Solana (FkeGp...) with about $67M liquidity, which matches the long-established Prom (PROM) project.

authenticity.evidence: There are 10 paid DexScreener boosts, 550 bundler wallets and 1,000 fresh wallets per GMGN, and a 43% bot/degen rate. The product itself pays people to post #ad shills. Volume of $1.6M against a market cap of about $94k suggests bot or wash trading. The creator has sold out and a community-takeover flag is set. No organic Reddit, news or X discussion turned up in search.
authenticity.uncertainty: X is barely indexed and the linked post was not readable. Real crypto-Twitter attention may exist that I cannot see.

structural_risks: 550 bundler wallets and a large share of fresh wallets can dump into about $28-31k of liquidity
Entry would come right after a +60% 5-minute and +164% 30-minute spike, so a retrace is likely
The creator has fully exited, leaving no owner commitment
Overhead supply sits between $110k and $342k from buyers at the all-time high
Only $28k of liquidity, so a -50% move can happen quickly

structured_output.counterargument: This looks like the canonical token for a real, working product in the active pump.fun creator-fee meta. The LP is burned, so liquidity cannot be pulled; about 5,000 holders and 40 smart wallets are involved, and the top-10 concentration is low at about 18%. It has already shown it can reach $342k. Doubling from about $110k to $220k only takes it back to about 65% of that high, and a V-shaped recovery with heavy volume often retests the high within hours. If @usePromX or bigger accounts push it, 2x is quite reachable.
unknowns: Whether @usePromX officially endorses this contract (the linked post was unreadable)
What X engagement and KOL involvement actually look like
Whether the bundler wallets still hold supply or have already exited
The cause of the current bounce: a real catalyst, or a coordinated pump using the boosts

source_coverage.notes: The X status returned HTTP 402 and nitter refused the connection. Searching the contract address returned nothing relevant. The pump.fun API confirmed the metadata. DexScreener showed a live price of about $0.000114.

structured_output.thesis: A real but tiny paid-shill product, likely the canonical token, trading in a very bot-heavy, boosted, dev-exited structure. It has already made one large pump and dump and is now in a sharp dead-cat or recovery bounce. Doubling to about $220k is possible given the earlier $342k high. But entering right after a vertical 5-minute spike, with 550 bundlers and paid boosts, makes hitting the -50% stop first more likely.
